The Evening

Coffee, chrome & couture — all in one night

Cars and Cafe's year-end celebration turns our drive-in arena into an open-air runway. Participants walk between a showcase of vintage classics, superbikes and modified cars, with the café serving its full menu through the evening.

Every participant walks two main rounds, gets a professional photo portfolio shot at the car showcase, and a certificate. Finalists from every category return for the Grand Finale round and a short Q&A with the judges before the crowns are announced under the string lights.

  • Round 1 Introduction Walk — your signature style, western or fusion
  • Round 2 Retro Wheels — vintage-inspired looks matched to the classic cars
  • Round 3 Grand Finale — evening glamour + judges' Q&A (finalists only)

Good to know

Rules of the runway

Simple, fair and family-friendly — the same for every category.

  • Age is counted as on 27 December 2026; carry a photo ID on show day.
  • Kids and Teens must be accompanied by a parent or guardian throughout.
  • Outfits for both main rounds — plus an evening-glamour outfit if you are shortlisted for the finale — are arranged by the participant; backstage changing rooms and styling support are provided.
  • Costumes must be family-friendly — the show is an all-ages café event.
  • Judging: walk & confidence 40%, styling 30%, stage presence 20%, Q&A 10% (finalists).
  • The judges' decision is final. Cash prizes are paid by bank transfer within 7 working days.
  • Entry fee is refundable in full if the event is postponed or cancelled.
  • Reporting after 3:30 PM may move you to the waitlist — please be on time.

Questions

Before you ask

I've never walked a runway. Can I still join?

Absolutely — most of our participants are first-timers. The 3:30 PM rehearsal and grooming session on show day covers walk basics, poses and stage cues, and our choreographer walks every category through their rounds before the show starts.

Do I arrange my own outfits and makeup?

Outfits for the two main rounds are yours to arrange — that's where your personal style scores. Shortlisted finalists also bring an evening-glamour outfit for the finale. Backstage changing rooms, mirrors and a styling support team for touch-ups are provided free on show day.

Can family and friends watch?

Yes — audience entry is completely free. Gates open at 4:00 PM with the car and bike showcase, and the café serves its full menu all evening. Seating is first-come, so arriving early helps.

How and when are prizes paid?

Winners are announced at 8:45 PM on show night. Cash prizes are transferred to the winner's bank account within 7 working days; crowns, trophies and hampers are handed over on stage.

What if my category fills up?

Each category is capped (Kids 30, Teens 25, Women 25, Men 20, Couples 20 pairs). Once a category fills, new entries join its waitlist and are offered slots in order if anyone withdraws.
